steps.name: Remove all decorative emojis from Razor files
steps.prompt:
Remove decorative emojis from all Razor files in C:\Users\Asus\Desktop\CodeQuest. The goal is a clean, professional UI that does not look AI-generated. Read every file before editing it. Run dotnet build at the end. Must be 0 errors 0 warnings.

RULES:
- KEEP: ← → arrows (navigation), — em dash (punctuation), • bullet (punctuation), ✕ and ✕ (close button X), ▶ (run code button), ✔ (finish lesson checkmark), plain text labels
- REMOVE: all decorative heading emojis, status emojis, nav link emojis, map emojis, coin/gold emojis, crown/lock/medal emojis
- For home page feature card icons (📜 ⚔️ 🏆): replace with simple SVG icons or just remove the icon div entirely and let the heading carry the card
- For NavMenu links: remove the emoji prefix, keep just the text label
- For battle feedback: replace ✅/❌ with styled text spans using CSS classes (feedback-correct / feedback-wrong already exist)
- For leaderboard medals: replace 🥇🥈🥉 with plain text rank numbers (1, 2, 3) styled with rank-gold/rank-silver/rank-bronze CSS classes
- For the mute button: replace 🔊/🔇 with text 'Sound On' / 'Sound Off'
- For ZonePage modal: remove emoji prefixes from headings, keep the text
- For map loading: remove ⚔️ from loading text, just say 'Loading zone map...'
- For BattlePage: remove 🏆 from Victory heading (keep 'Victory!'), remove 💀 from Defeated (keep 'Defeated!'), remove 🎉 from level up, remove 🪙 coin from gold display (replace with 'gold'), remove 👑 boss indicator (the boss-crown CSS div already handles it visually), remove ❓ from Question heading, remove 🧙 from hero name display
- For LessonPage: remove 📖 📜 🧠 💻 emoji prefixes from headings, remove ✅ from 'Already completed' (keep the text), remove ✨ from completion callout
- For Map.razor: remove ⚔️ from hero avatar div (the CSS gradient circle is enough), remove 🏔/🔒 from zone card headings, remove 🪙 from gold display, remove 🗺 from World Map heading, remove 🏆 from Leaderboard link, replace lock padlock 🔒 with plain text 'Locked'
- For Tutorial.razor: remove emoji difficulty dots from badge spans, keep the badge text (Easy/Medium/Hard and monster names)
- For Teacher pages: remove all emoji prefixes from h2 headings (📖 👾 ❓ 📊 🗺), keep the heading text
- For HomeLayout nav brand: change '⚔️ CodeQuest' to just 'CodeQuest'
- For Home.razor feature cards: replace the home-card-icon divs with nothing, or a simple styled number/letter. Remove the emoji entirely.
- For NavMenu brand link: remove ⚔ from 'CodeQuest'
- For ZonePage coming-soon node: remove 🔒, replace with text 'Soon'
- For ZonePage modal BOSS label: remove 👑, just show 'BOSS'
- For BattlePage monster fallback: keep 👾 (it only shows when no sprite image exists — it is functional)
- For BattlePage boss crown indicator (@_challenge?.IsBoss == true ? '👑' : ''): remove it, the boss-crown CSS div already adds a visual crown
- App.razor dismiss span (🗙): replace with plain '×'

After all changes: run dotnet build. Report 0 errors 0 warnings.
